title: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
synopsis: The journey to Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 begins in Agnipareeksha, where commoner contestants battle for a place in the Bigg Boss House.

title: Prince of Mollywood
synopsis: Firoz has one dream: become a Pan-Indian superstar. But everyone around him has other plans. His friends are experts at ruining things. Vappa Mammali turns producer hoping one flop will send him straight back to the family business. Umma is busy finding him a bride on matrimony sites. And then there's his girlfriend.

title: Kerala Underground
synopsis: Kerala Underground is a first-of-its-kind Malayalam hip-hop reality series that explores the voices, stories, and culture shaping Kerala's rapidly growing rap movement.
